segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ סֵדֶר נַחֲלוֹת כָּךְ הוּא: ״אִישׁ כִּי יָמוּת וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ, וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְבִתּוֹ״ – בֵּן קוֹדֵם לַבַּת, כׇּל יוֹצְאֵי יְרֵיכוֹ שֶׁל בֵּן קוֹדְמִין לַבַּת. בַּת קוֹדֶמֶת לָאַחִין, יוֹצְאֵי יְרֵיכָהּ שֶׁל בַּת קוֹדְמִין לָאַחִין. אַחִין קוֹדְמִין לַאֲחֵי הָאָב, יוֹצְאֵי יְרֵיכָן שֶׁל אַחִין קוֹדְמִין לַאֲחֵי הָאָב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The «order» of precedence with regard to «inheritances is this:» The verse states: «“If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall pass his inheritance to his daughter”» (Numbers 27:8). This teaches that «a son precedes a daughter.» Additionally, «all descendants of a son precede a daughter. A daughter precedes the brothers» of the deceased. Additionally, the «descendants of a daughter precede the brothers» of the deceased. «Brothers» of the deceased «precede the uncles» of the deceased. Additionally, the «descendants of the brothers precede the uncles.»

segments.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל: כׇּל הַקּוֹדֵם בַּנַּחֲלָה – יוֹצְאֵי יְרֵיכוֹ קוֹדְמִין. וְהָאָב קוֹדֵם לְכׇל יוֹצְאֵי יְרֵיכוֹ.
segments.en: «This is the principle:» Concerning «anyone who precedes» another «with regard to inheritance, his descendants precede» the other as well, «and a father» who inherits «precedes all of his descendants.»

moves.summary: general principle: whoever precedes, his descendants precede; father precedes his descendants

edges.cueHe: איש כי ימות ובן אין לו ... בן קודם לבת
edges.about: the verse teaches a son precedes a daughter

positions.claim: son and his descendants precede daughter; daughter and hers precede brothers; brothers and theirs precede uncles; the father precedes his descendants
